description: Drafts a non-disclosure agreement in German or English from the KULIC Advisory NDA template (Execution Toolkit Library T22): mutual or one-way, two parties with address and representative, purpose, effective date, confidentiality term of 1, 2, 3 or 5 years, governing law and an optional place of jurisdiction. Returns the full text with ten sections and signature blocks, ready to paste into a document or email, and the link to the free web tool that creates the same agreement as Word and PDF in the browser and sends it from the user's own email app. Working template, not legal advice. Licence, or one free check every 30 days.

effective_date.description: Effective date as YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today.

governing_law.description: germany (default), austria, switzerland, england_wales, or the name of another jurisdiction.

jurisdiction.description: Optional place of jurisdiction, for example Cologne.

kind.description: mutual: both parties share information (default). one_way: only party A discloses, party B receives.

language.description: Language of the agreement and the answer. Default de.

party_a.description: Party A (in a one-way NDA the disclosing party).

title.description: Position of the person who signs.

party_b.description: Party B (in a one-way NDA the receiving party).

title.description: Position of the person who signs.

purpose.description: Purpose in one sentence. Default: evaluation of a possible collaboration.

name: create_nda
title: Draft a mutual or one-way non-disclosure agreement (NDA) from the KULIC Advisory NDA template
